Sandbox_MarzGuns_VanillaWeaponReplacemen: Enable Vanilla Weapon Replacement with GoM counterpart.
Sandbox_MarzGuns_VanillaAmmoReplacement_: Enable Vanilla Ammo Replacement with GoM counterpart.
Sandbox_MarzGuns_VanillaAttachmentReplac: Enable Vanilla Attachments Replacement with GoM counterpart.
Sandbox_MarzGuns_LootMultiplier_tooltip: Scales how often Guns of Marz weapons, attachments and magazines are injected into world loot, vehicles and bags. 1.0 = default, higher = more common, 0 = disable GoM loot injection.
Sandbox_MarzGuns_SpawnHighCapMags_toolti: Allow extended / drum magazines (50+ round AR, Russian drums, big pistol/SMG sticks) to appear in loot. Disable for a more grounded game.
Sandbox_MarzGuns_SpawnExplosives_tooltip: Allow fragmentation grenades, smoke and incendiary devices to spawn in military and police loot. Off by default.
Sandbox_MarzGuns_Enable_TacticalReload_t: Enable Tactical Reload feature. Quickly swap magazines by dropping one on the floor
